title: Suspension of TROY (BSC) Deposits (2025-01-03)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, To ensure the safety and protection of users, deposits for TROY (BSC) were  suspended on 2025-01-02  due to a potential security issue involving the TROY-BEP20 token contract.  Binance will cease support of the token on the BSC network to further protect our users.  Binance is actively working to verify with the project regarding the collateral for the minted tokens on BSC. Unfortunately, the project team has not provided sufficient clarification regarding this issue at this time.  Binance  may  reopen deposits for TROY if it is deemed to be safe to do so, but no separate announcement will be issued.  Please Note: Other services related to the aforementioned token, such as deposits and withdrawals via Ethereum Network (ETH), will  not  be affected.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. We thank you for your support as we continue to build the crypto ecosystem in a way that promotes transparency and long-term, sustainable growth. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-01-03
